svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 1550 long; deburr; round the near end edge with a file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 10 cross holes at 100 pitch along its whole length,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the first 50 from the near end, all in one line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each hole with the pit width it suits (punch marks).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: slides inside the pivot tube; one lynch pin through both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tubes sets the reach; the far stand clamps on it in a split sleeve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Not needed for pits up to 1.22 m wide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: at least 250 of it stays inside the pivot tube when pinned.
